nodes.label: The real TST-MD engine does NOT reproduce the paper's cell-ECM coupling. Engi...
nodes.statement: The real TST-MD engine does NOT reproduce the paper's cell-ECM coupling. Engine instrumentation (rebuilt bin/adhesions, logged AdhesionMover) shows the CPM DOES move adhesions (876 commits, ~1.27px/frame) and the CPM->MD sync works — so it is NOT a sync bug. The obstruction is BISTABILITY: the ECM resistance adh_dh is ~constant (fibers aren't dragged -> no densification -> no stiffening feedback), so the engine only ever fully holds the cell (lambda<=3, no contraction) or lets it collapse leaving the adhesions behind (lambda>=4), even at 2000 MCS with gradient selection. No drag-to-new-equilibrium regime is reachable from any ymmsl parameter. See followup_proposals + viva-tstmd/docs/cell-ecm-coupling.md.

nodes.label: What DOES hold (sub-reproduction): the cell genuinely contracts (13000 -> ~0)...
nodes.statement: What DOES hold (sub-reproduction): the cell genuinely contracts (13000 -> ~0) and shows weak reorientation (q/q0 ~1.09). But these are not the paper's remodeling result; densification stays ~0. A real bridge bug (float-typed settings written as ints) was found + fixed while investigating, which unblocked the parameter search.

nodes.label: The real engine does NOT reproduce the paper's percolated network at CPU-trac...
nodes.statement: The real engine does NOT reproduce the paper's percolated network at CPU-tractable sizes: the giant component saturates at ~0.30 and never approaches full percolation (~1.0). The connectivity onset is reproduced; the percolated regime is not.

nodes.label: Sub-reproduction that DOES hold: crosslinking sharply raises connectivity fro...
nodes.statement: Sub-reproduction that DOES hold: crosslinking sharply raises connectivity from a disconnected network (0.0007 -> 0.18 at the first crosslinks) — the onset direction of Fig 2B. Reaching full percolation likely needs near-paper-scale densities beyond what runs CPU-tractably here.
